reviewed_by: Codex review of reasoning-only final-answer recovery
reason: A provider can complete final synthesis with reasoning but no operator-facing content and an ordinary stop finish reason. Core now identifies that response as reasoning_only across streaming, non-streaming, and post-tool synthesis, performs one bounded synthesis-only retry with more output room when the operator did not set a cap, retains safe per-attempt response metadata, and exposes a distinct retryable failure contract after exhaustion. Manual retry resumes the durable failed turn without replaying prior tool work. The selected Python tests cover direct, streaming API, and tool-loop recovery; provider-thinking Playwright verifies the exact visible retry workflow on desktop, Chromium mobile, and WebKit mobile; durable-conversation-core verifies production real-Core persistence and reload.
exclusions: No frontend unit test is selected because the new action is an SSE-to-session integration exercised by the focused Playwright journey rather than an isolated component contract. No native tests because no Rust or desktop-shell code changed. Provider transport internals, model catalog, MCP, hooks, workspace mutation, unrelated chat workflows, and full suites are excluded. The calm-CSS audit is not selected because no styles changed; its existing repository-wide baseline violations remain unrelated.
